mapper.sql: select e.cruise_result_id, f.cruise_data_id, a.device_id, b.device_mete_id, d.instance_id, b.mete_type, q.dict_note as mete_type_name, f.evaluation_state, p.dict_note as evaluation_state_name, a.device_name , (CASE WHEN ISNULL(n.mete_name) AND ISNULL(m.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(n.mete_name) AND ISNULL(m.inspection_name) THEN k.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(n.mete_name) AND ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN m.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(m.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN n.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(m.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT(n.mete_name,'/',k.preset_name) WHEN ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN CONCAT(n.mete_name,'/',m.inspection_name) END) AS instance_name, h.dict_note as identify_result, f.origpic as picpath, g.dict_note as cruise_result, e.cruise_time FROM t_std_device a LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b on a.device_id = b.device_id and a.custom_id = b.custom_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance d on b.device_mete_id = d.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail e on e.instance_id = d.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result f on e.cruise_result_id = f.cruise_result_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business g on g.dict_code = f.state LEFT JOIN t_dict_business h on h.dict_code = f.identify_result LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset k ON d.cruise_id = k.preset_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection m ON m.inspection_id = d.cruise_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete n ON n.device_mete_id = d.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business p on p.dict_code = f.evaluation_state LEFT JOIN t_dict_business q on q.dict_code = b.mete_type

select q.task_id, e.cruise_result_id, f.cruise_data_id, a.device_id, b.device_mete_id, d.instance_id, b.mete_type, w.dict_note as mete_type_name, f.evaluation_state, x.dict_note as evaluation_state_name, a.device_name , (CASE WHEN ISNULL(n.mete_name) AND ISNULL(m.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN '' WHEN ISNULL(n.mete_name) AND ISNULL(m.inspection_name) THEN k.preset_name WHEN ISNULL(n.mete_name) AND ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN m.inspection_name WHEN ISNULL(m.inspection_name) AND ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN n.mete_name WHEN ISNULL(m.inspection_name) THEN CONCAT(n.mete_name,'/',k.preset_name) WHEN ISNULL(k.preset_name) THEN CONCAT(n.mete_name,'/',m.inspection_name) END) AS instance_name, h.dict_note as identify_result, f.origpic as picpath, g.dict_note as cruise_result, e.cruise_time FROM t_std_device a LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete b on a.device_id = b.device_id and a.custom_id = b.custom_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_point_instance d on b.device_mete_id = d.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_task_result_detail e on e.instance_id = d.instance_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_data_result f on e.cruise_result_id = f.cruise_result_id LEFT JOIN t_cruise_result q on q.task_result_id = e.task_result_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business g on g.dict_code = f.state LEFT JOIN t_dict_business h on h.dict_code = f.identify_result LEFT JOIN t_camera_preset k ON d.cruise_id = k.preset_id LEFT JOIN t_robot_inspection m ON m.inspection_id = d.cruise_id LEFT JOIN t_std_devicemete n ON n.device_mete_id = d.device_mete_id LEFT JOIN t_dict_business w on w.dict_code = b.mete_type LEFT JOIN t_dict_business x on x.dict_code = f.evaluation_state
mapper.delete: delete from t_report_info WHERE report_name = #{reportName, jdbcType=VARCHAR} and generate_date = #{generateDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
mapper.select: SELECT a.report_name, a.report_type, a.generate_date FROM t_report_info a WHERE 1 = 1 and a.report_name like concat ('%',#{reportName,jdbcType=VARCHAR},'%') and generate_date BETWEEN #{startTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND #{endTime, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}
mapper.insert: insert into t_report_info( report_name, report_type, generate_date, remarks )values( #{reportName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{reportType, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{generateDate, jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}, #{remarks, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT a.station_name FROM t_std_region a WHERE a.up_region_id = -1

SELECT COUNT(device_mete_id or null) as mete_num from (
where 1 = 1 and a.device_id in
#{deviceIds, jdbcType=BIGINT}
GROUP BY device_mete_id )big_table

SELECT dict_note as meteType, (SELECT COUNT(*) from (
where 1 = 1 and a.device_id in
#{deviceIds, jdbcType=BIGINT}
GROUP BY device_mete_id ) big_table where mete_type = dict_code ) as meteNum, 0 as regular_num from t_dict_business where dict_code IN ( select dict_code from t_dict_business where col_name = 'mete_type' ) ORDER BY dict_code

SELECT dict_note as meteType, (SELECT COUNT(*) from (
where 1 = 1 and task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} GROUP BY device_mete_id ) big_table where mete_type = dict_code ) as meteNum, 0 as regular_num from t_dict_business where dict_code IN ( select dict_code from t_dict_business where col_name = 'mete_type' ) ORDER BY dict_code
SELECT a.task_name, b.execute_time as cruise_date from t_cruise_task a LEFT JOIN t_cruise_result b on b.task_id = a.task_id where 1 = 1 and a.task_id = #{taskId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
